synthetic-specimen-scout.summary: A slender toy-like alien scout crouched on digitigrade webbed limbs with a blank egg-like head and an overhead scanning arch.
synthetic-specimen-scout.pose: Poised in a deep digitigrade crouch with splayed webbed feet and planted knuckles, raising a pristine spherical token beneath an arched scanning sensor.

auxiliary-proboscis-turret.summary: An upright ribbed biological sleeve with an everted toothed secondary maw extending outward.

umbilical-rib-pylon.summary: A tall ribbed vertebral pylon arched inward like the creature's dorsal spine segment.

bio-conduit-spool.summary: A heavy synthetic coil spooling thick flexible conduits that loop along the rim.

specimen-pod-rack.summary: A modular ground rack housing two translucent spherical cores in molded indentations.

things.text: A core token, still warm from the incubation pit.
